game: TB @ NO Week 8 2025, kickoff 2025-10-26 16:05 ET, Caesars Superdome (dome)

script.base: Morning-of read only: TB is favored (NO +4.5, total 46.5, implied TB 25.5 / NO 21.0) in a dome, so the book expects a moderate TB lead rather than a shootout or a slog. Base flow is TB ahead by a score at half and late, then clock-killing with Rachaad White (Bucky Irving out; 41 carries, 144 yards in weeks 5-7) while Spencer Rattler's Saints stay pass-tilted to Chris Olave (28 targets, 255 yards, 347 air yards in that window) and Rashid Shaheed. Alvin Kamara's rush line stays inefficient (29 carries, 86 yards, 2.97 YPC) against a TB front that has allowed 4.02 YPC and only 16 runs of 10+.
script.flip1: TB gets up big early — Mayfield is fine when not blitzed (TB EPA/db +0.26 vs no blitz) — NO abandons the run, Kamara's carries die, Olave/Shaheed/Juwan Johnson targets spike, and White's late rush volume rises while TB WR yards stall.
script.flip2: NO's 33% blitz bothers Mayfield (TB EPA/db vs blitz -0.15) and/or Vita Vea (questionable, foot) sits, so Kamara and Kendre Miller (19 carries, 69 yards in weeks 5-7) control the ground, the game stays low-event, and Olave never gets the explosive shots.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and this lost because TB took Olave away and Rattler lived in the middle the Bucs actually bleed (9.48 YPA): Juwan's 79-yard game repeated and Shaheed (278 air yards in three games) took the explosives, leaving Olave on a 20-yard repeat. Separately Vea was inactive, Kamara broke one long run early, NO stayed close, and 12-15 carries at even 3.5 YPC cleared 42.5. The counter-case is stronger on Kamara than on Olave, which is why Kamara is a lean and why a Vea inactive scratch would kill that leg before kickoff.
